name: Truc y Flou
summary: Six-player Spanish-suited team Truc game with embit and flor declarations, trick-taking and permitted partner signalling.
rules_text: Played by six in two teams of three with 40 Spanish-suited cards (48 minus 8s,9s). Deal 3 cards each anticlockwise. Cards rank for tricks in a fixed hierarchy; two cards are periques (Jack of Coins, Knight of Clubs) acting as wild 7s for declarations. Aim: first team to 25 game points. Play has declarations during first trick: embit = two suited cards in one hand scoring sum+20, flor = three suited cards scoring sum+20. Players may bid j'embide for 1 point or flor for 3 points; opponents may fold for 2 or raise to 1,2,10 or restou (remaining points to win). If contested, highest declaration by card-points wins raised amount; tie broken by position nearest dealer's right. Flor nullifies embits. After declarations, play 3 tricks; team winning most tricks scores 1. Captains in middle receive discreet signals about high cards and direct tactics. Beans and espintou mark points.
rating_reason: Partnership bluff game with allowed signaling, bargaining element.
